name: Mycenae - Ruins Structure
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: hellojaviergarcia
description: Mycenae is an ancient monument in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, inspired by the Tomb of Agamemnon in Greece, featuring a massive beehive-shaped burial chamber, grand stone walls, and a mysterious entrance passage.
works: Mycenae is an ancient monument in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, inspired by the Tomb of Agamemnon in Greece, featuring a massive beehive-shaped burial chamber, grand stone walls, and a mysterious entrance passage: its structures generate in new worlds.
note: From Modrinth, unchanged; a new world needed (structures generate with new chunks)
